#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else "repo").resolve()
checks=[]
def check(label, ok, detail=""): checks.append({"label":label,"ok":bool(ok),"detail":str(detail)})
import json
j=repo/"sitemap.json"; data=json.loads(j.read_text()) if j.exists() else {}
pages=data.get("pages",data if isinstance(data,list) else [])
urls=[str(x.get("url",x.get("path",""))) for x in pages] if isinstance(pages,list) else []
check("json sitemap",len(pages)>=8,len(pages))
check("unique pages",len(urls)==len(set(urls)))
check("titles statuses links",all(("title" in x and ("status" in x or "status_code" in x) and ("links" in x or "outlinks" in x)) for x in pages))
check("broken link recorded",any("missing" in str(x).lower() for x in pages) or "missing" in j.read_text().lower())
h=repo/"sitemap.html"; check("html map",h.exists() and h.stat().st_size>1200)
shots=list((repo/"screenshots").glob("*.png")) if (repo/"screenshots").exists() else []
valid=sum(p.read_bytes()[:8]==b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" and p.stat().st_size>3000 for p in shots)
check("page screenshots",valid>=8,f"{valid} valid")
check("rerunnable crawler",any((repo/x).exists() for x in ["crawl.py","crawler.py","run.sh","Makefile"]))
score=sum(x["ok"] for x in checks)
print(json.dumps({"project":"p7-local-site-crawl","score":score,"max_score":len(checks),"checks":checks},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if score==len(checks) else 1)
